description: Change input array position incrementing to a decrementing operation, causing an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException or wrong data read.
Change the loop condition from i < inAvail to i <= inAvail, causing an off-by-one error and reading past the intended input bounds.
Change the modulus increment operator from pre-increment (++modulus) to post-increment (modulus++), which alters the modulus cycle tracking state.
Change the shift operator in the modulus 2 EOF padding case from right shift 16 to right shift 8, resulting in corrupted output data for 2-byte leftover blocks.
Change the bitwise AND mask from MASK_8BITS to 0 in the modulus 3 EOF decoding block, zeroing out the second decoded byte.
